chunk_text: All serious adverse events must be reported to the regulatory authority and ethics committee. Demo placeholder: within 24 hours of site awareness.
Non-serious adverse events should be recorded in the trial master file and summarised in periodic safety reports. Demo placeholder: 15 days.
For Ayurveda interventions, also document the formulation/batch (e.g. Ashwagandha churna batch no.) in the AE narrative.
Ethics committee approval is typically valid for one year and must be renewed before expiry to continue enrolment.
